verdict.rationale: Capacities is a SaaS note-taking app with a public REST API and MCP integration, so asking whether it offers a sandbox or test environment is a fair question. The evidence documents no sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production environment. Several items come close but don't qualify: unlimited spaces would let a user set up a throwaway test space themselves, which is a workaround. Version history to undo assistant edits is an adjacent control. The interactive try-it API dashboard uses a real token against live content, so it doesn't isolate production data.
